card.name: Words leading into additive drug effects
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, a, the) or punctuation right before an expected description of an additive or combined effect, mostly in drug interaction text about blood pressure lowering.

modes.label: Article before additive effect
modes.description: The word an or a right after verbs like have, cause, produce, where 'additive effect' comes next.
modes.example: ensive agents (e.g., vasodilators, angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, diuretics, beta blockers) will usually have<< an>> additive effect on lowering blood pressure. Monitor

modes.label: Punctuation or dash before effect on blood pressure
modes.description: A comma, dash or bracket after a drug combination or dose, before a change in blood pressure is reported.
